item.stem:
Esha looks at the diagram. Straight line $ROS$ passes through $O$, and ray $OT$ cuts the straight angle into adjacent angles $\angle ROT$ and $\angle TOS$. The marked angle $\angle ROT$ is $55^{\circ}$.

Which claim correctly finds $\angle TOS$?

options.A: $\angle TOS=180^{\circ}$, the measure of the whole straight angle at $O$.
options.B: $\angle TOS=180^{\circ}-55^{\circ}=125^{\circ}$, because the adjacent parts of the straight angle add to $180^{\circ}$.
options.C: $\angle TOS=55^{\circ}$, matching the printed degree mark on $\angle ROT$.
